imageLicense.name: Mixed: MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD code; CC-BY-4.0 weights; Charsiu aligner declares no license
imageLicense.note: Bundles voxtream 0.1.5 (MIT; SesameAI depth transformer Apache-2.0), moshi 0.2.2 and the Mimi codec weights kyutai/moshiko-pytorch-bf16 (code MIT/Apache-2.0, weights CC-BY-4.0), IDRnD/ReDimNet (MIT), charsiu/en_w2v2_fc_10ms and charsiu/tokenizer_en_cmu (each model card declares no license; the Charsiu project is MIT - review before redistributing), NLTK data, PyTorch (BSD-3-Clause), and the two sample voices from the VoXtream repository. VoXtream weights: attribute the Emilia and HiFiTTS-2 datasets (CC-BY-4.0).

validation.note: Custom image infra/docker/voxtream.Dockerfile (voxtream 0.1.5 on torch 2.8 cu129; all auxiliary weights baked in and pinned; runs with no network). Measured on a GB10: about 5.4 GiB resident, healthy in about 30 s, first audio about 150 ms (whole text) or 320 ms (word-by-word input), about 2x faster than real time. English only; voices are the two samples bundled from the VoXtream repository.
